Ticket T-0011: Pin that one pi-ai stream() call makes exactly one provider request on a retryable failure.
You are the Llm Pi Ai Steward (seat `harness-core-llm-pi-ai-steward`) of the `harness-core` division, working this ticket in your own git worktree on your own branch.
Task: Problem: the adapter passes `maxRetries: 0` to the pi-ai SDK (packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/adapter.ts:96-97: 'The agent recovery layer owns visible attempts; one adapter call is one SDK attempt') and the README promises at packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/README.md:118 that one `stream()` call makes one provider request, so that `dsh-llm-retry` and the session log own every visible attempt. Nothing pins it on a failure the SDK would retry: packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/tests/adapter.spec.ts asserts a single request only where no retry could happen (an unsupported reasoning effort refused before sending, :560; a consumer abort, :987). A pi-ai upgrade that re-enabled retries, or a lost `maxRetries: 0`, would multiply requests and hide attempts from `llm/retry` without failing a test.

Required: add packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/tests/single-attempt.spec.ts using the existing `mockServer` helper (packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/tests/mock-server.ts already scripts a non-200 `status` with headers) with a scripted response the SDK treats as retryable: one test with a 500 and one with a 429 carrying a `retry-after` header. Drive the real adapter through `ctx.llm.stream()` as adapter.spec.ts does and assert that the stream finishes with `kind: 'error'` carrying the mapped code (`SERVER`, `RATE_LIMIT`) and that `server.requests` has length 1 after the finish settles.

Constraints: do not mock pi-ai; extend tests/mock-server.ts only if a status-only script cannot express the case; no source change.

You are the Third-Party Notices Standard Author (seat `governance-third-party-notices-standard-author`) of the `governance` division, working this ticket in your own git worktree on your own branch.
Task: Problem: scripts/gen-third-party-notices.ts:69-71 overrides `oxlint` and `oxlint-tsgolint` with `{ license: 'MIT', repo }` under the comment "Rust workspaces publishing npm bins without `license` in package.json." The installed manifests now carry both fields: oxlint 1.76.0 declares `"license": "MIT"` and `repository: { type: 'git', url: 'git+https://github.com/oxc-project/oxc', directory: 'npm/oxlint' }`, and oxlint-tsgolint 7.0.2001 declares `"license": "MIT"` and `repository: { url: 'github:oxc-project/tsgolint' }` (read them with `node -e` over the paths `ls -d node_modules/.pnpm/*/node_modules/oxlint/package.json node_modules/.pnpm/*/node_modules/oxlint-tsgolint/package.json` print). scripts/gen-third-party-notices.ts:63-66 states the rule for `OVERRIDES`: an entry exists only where the installed manifest is wrong or unreachable, and each entry documents why. The reason for these two no longer holds, so the override masks what the store says and would keep masking a future relicensing. The `@modelcontextprotocol/server-*` entries (still `SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE`) and the `node-addon-require-builtin` entry (still no `repository` field) remain justified.
